lesson.name: Learn The Petroff Defense
lesson.description: The Petroff Defense is one of the most solid defenses against 1.e4. Learn the key ideas for both sides.

{Black should play d6 to attack White's knight before capturing on e4. How can
White win material?} 4. Qe2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Use your queen to attack on the open e-file.]} (4. d4 $2 d5 {Black is
OK. Try to find a stronger move.}) (4. Qf3 $2 Nf6 {Black is OK. Try to find a
better move.}) 4... Nf6 {Good start! Black should have played Qe7, which only
lets White emerge with an extra pawn. Now White has a famous trap which wins
the black queen. What should you play?} 5. Nc6+ {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find it.] [%hint Attack the black queen with discovered check.]} (5.
Ng6+ $5 {White wins material, but there's an even better option. Try to find
it.}) (5. Nxf7+ $2 Kxf7 {Black is winning. Try again.}) 5... Qe7 {Great move!
What's next?} 6. Nxe7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint
Capture the queen with your knight.] Great job! White is winning.} (6. Qxe7+ $2
Bxe7 {That's just an even trade. Try to find a better capture.}) *

{How should Black save the e4-knight?} 5... Qe7 {[%wrong White wins material.
Try again and look for the best way to defend your knight.] [%hint Defend your
knight and break the pin on the e-file.]} (5... f5 $2 6. d3 {White uses a pin
to win the e4-knight. Try again and look for a better way to defend your
knight.}) (5... d5 $2 6. d3 {White uses a pin to win the e4-knight. Try again
and look for a better way to defend your knight.}) (5... Bf5 $2 6. d3 {White
uses a pin to win the e4-knight. Try again and look for a better way to defend
your knight.}) 6. d3 {Great move! How should you save your knight?} Nf6 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to save your
knight.] [%hint Retreat your knight to a safe square.] Good defensive play!
The Qe2 line is rare on the top level because this position is nearly
symmetrical and Black has no difficulties.} (6... Nc5 $2 7. Nc3 {Black avoids
material losses, but the knight will soon be vulnerable to attack on the
c5-square. Try again and look for a stronger knight move.}) (6... Ng5 $2 7.
Bxg5 {White wins a knight. Try again and look for a better knight move.}) *

{When White is able to open the g-file to attack, Black has a difficult
defense ahead. What's the only move that keeps Black in the game?} 16... Re6 {
[%wrong White has a winning attack. Try again and check the hint if you're
stuck.] [%hint Defend the sixth rank to prepare a way to evict the h6-bishop.]}
(16... Kh8 $2 17. Rxg7 {This was played in Shirov - Bogner 2017, but White had
a winning attack. Try again and look for a better defensive move.}) (16... g6
$2 17. h5 {White will open the kingside with a deadly attack. Try again and
check the hint if you're stuck.}) (16... bxc5 $2 17. Rxg7+ {White sacrifices
for a winning kingside attack. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.})
(16... Kf8 $2 17. Rxg7 {White sacrifices for a winning kingside attack. Try
again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) 17. Bxg7 {Great move! White would
have been better off retreating the h6-bishop. How should Black win material?}
Bxg7 {[%wrong White has a winning attack. Try again and look for a good
defensive option.] [%hint Recapture on the kingside.] Great work! White has no
way to safely add attackers to the g7-bishop and Black should soon convert the
extra piece into a win.} *

{How did GM Alexei Shirov break open the black kingside?} 17. Rxg7 {[%wrong
There's a better attacking option. Try again and look for a winning sacrifice.]
[%hint Sacrifice a rook to expose the black king.]} (17. Bxg7+ $5 {This is a
great move, but Shirov preferred another sacrifice on g7. What did he play?}) (
17. cxb6 $2 axb6 {Back opens the a-file with a good position. Try again and
look for a stronger attacking move.}) (17. Bg5 $2 bxc5 {Black wins a pawn with
a good position. Try again and look for a stronger attacking option.}) (17. Bf4
$2 bxc5 {Black wins a pawn with a good position. Try again and look for a
stronger attacking option.}) (17. Bxh7 $2 Kxh7 {It's much stronger to
sacrifice on the dark squares around the black king. How should you do it?})
17... Bxg7 {Great start! How can you continue the attack?} 18. Bxg7+ {[%wrong
Black has a winning material advantage. Try again and look for a way to force
the black king into danger.] [%hint Sacrifice to make the black king come to
the g-file.]} (18. Rg1 $2 Rg8 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a
more forcing attacking option.}) 18... Kxg7 {Great work! How should White hunt
down the black king?} 19. Rg1+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try
again and look for a winning check.] [%hint Find a winning check on the g-file.
]} (19. Qg5+ $2 Qxg5+ {Black will win the endgame after a trade of queens. Try
again and look for a stronger check.}) (19. Qc3+ $2 f6 {Black is doing well.
Try again and look for a better check.}) 19... Bg4 {Good idea! Keep it up.} 20.
Rxg4+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture a piece with check.]} (20. fxg4 $2 Qxh4 {White
doesn't have enough compensation for the lost material. Try again and look for
a stronger capture.}) 20... Kf8 {Well played! How should you force the black
king into the open?} 21. Qh6+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
look for a good check.] [%hint Check and force the black king to the e-file.]
Well played! Every white piece joins the attack and Black soon resigned in
Shirov - Bogner 2017.} (21. Qf4 $5 {This is a good move, but Shirov found an
even better square for the queen. What did he play?}) (21. Bxh7 $2 Qf6 {
White has compensation for the sacrificed exchange, but no more. Try again and
look for a better attacking option.}) *

{White's compensation for the sacrificed piece isn't enough to win, but there
is enough play to hold a draw. What should you play?} 8. Qe2 {[%wrong There's
a stronger attacking option. Try again and look for a strong pin.] [%hint Pin
the e4-knight against Black's king.]} (8. Qxd5 $2 Ndf6 {Black is doing well.
Try again and look for a way to make a useful pin.}) (8. Bxe4 $2 dxe4 {Black
is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a useful pin.}) (8. Bg5+ $2
Nxg5 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a useful pin.})
(8. Qh4+ $2 Ndf6 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a
useful pin.}) 8... Kf7 {Great move! How should you keep Black's king on the
run?} 9. Qh5+ {[%wrong Black is doing well. Try again and look for a good
attacking option.] [%hint Fork the black king and an undefended pawn.] Good
work! Black must bring the king to the e-file and after Qe2 the game will
likely end with a draw by repetition.} (9. Qf3+ $2 Ndf6 {Black keeps a
material advantage. Try again and look for a good check.}) (9. Bxe4 $2 dxe4 {
Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a good check.}) (9. f3
$2 Qh4+ {Black has a winning attack. Try again and look for a useful check.}) *

{It's logical to attack e4, but White's made a tactical error. How can Black
win material?} 10... Nxf2 {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking move. Try
again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Sacrifice your knight to
threaten the white queen and reveal a discovery against the d3-bishop.]} (10...
dxc4 $2 11. Bxe4 {White wins material. Try again and look for a better capture.
}) (10... Nxd2 $2 11. Bxf5 {White has the bishop pair and a strong initiative.
Try again and look for a better capture.}) (10... Re8 $2 11. Qb3 {White is
doing well. Try again and look for a stronger attacking option.}) (10... Nc3 $2
11. Qc2 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a better discovered
attack.}) 11. Kxf2 {Great move! What's next?} Bxd3 {[%wrong White has a
winning material advantage. Try again and look for the best capture.] [%hint
Capture an undefended piece.] Great work! Black has an extra pawn and a good
position.} *

{How should Black take advantage of White's premature c2-c4 advance?} 6... Bb4+
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong check. ] 
[%hint Develop a piece with check.]} (6... c6 $2 7. Be2 {White is OK. Try
again and look for a way to develop with a forcing move.}) (6... Nc6 $2 7. a3 {
White is OK. Try again and look for a more forcing developing move.}) (6... Bd6
$2 7. Nc3 {There's a stronger option. Try again and look for a more forcing
bishop move.}) (6... dxc4 $2 7. Bxc4 {White is OK. Try again and look for a
way to develop with a forcing move.}) (6... Be7 $2 7. Nc3 {There's a stronger
option. Try again and look for a more forcing bishop move.}) (6... Nxf2 $2 7.
Kxf2 {White wins material. Try again and look for a strong check.}) (6... Bg4
$2 7. Qb3 {Black may have difficulty defending the b7-pawn. Try again and look
for a strong check.}) 7. Bd2 {Good start! How should Black eliminate White's
bishop pair?} Nxd2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Capture a bishop to eliminate White's bishop pair.]
Great job! Black has two bishops in an open position and good winning chances.}
(7... Bxd2+ $2 8. Nbxd2 {Black is doing well, but it's stronger to keep your
bishop while eliminating White's bishop pair. How should you do it?}) (7... Qe7
$2 8. Be2 {The queen may soon be vulnerable on the open file. Try again and
look for a strong capture.}) *

Great move! What's next?} Qxd5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again and look
for a good capture.] [%hint Capture the undefended white queen.] Great job!
This is a good tactical trick to know in many openings.} *

{How did GM Wesley So break open the kingside to start a strong attack?} 19. f5
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good pawn break.] 
[%hint Advance a pawn and aim to open the f-file.]} (19. d5 $2 Nxd5 {Black
wins material. Try again and look for a stronger pawn break.}) (19. Kg2 $2 a5 {
Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a way to open lines on the
kingside.}) (19. Kh1 $2 a5 {Black has a safe position. Try again and look for
a way to open lines on the kingside.}) (19. c4 $2 bxc4 {Black wins material.
Try again and look for a stronger pawn break.}) 19... Nd5 {Black attempted to
keep the position closed, but now White can win a pawn. How should you do it?}
20. fxg6 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn to attack the f7-pawn and expose the black
king.]} (20. Bxd5 $2 cxd5 {White is doing well, but there's a significantly
stronger capture. Try to find it.}) (20. a4 $2 bxa4 {White is doing well, but
there's a capture that's stronger. Try to find it.}) 20... fxg6 {Great move!
How should you win material?} 21. Bxd5+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try
again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece with check.]} (21.
Qg2 $2 Rxf1+ {Black takes over the initiative with a good position. Try again
and look for a strong check.}) (21. Qe2 $2 Rxf1+ {Black takes over the
initiative with a good position. Try again and look for a strong check.}) (21.
Qxf8+ $2 Bxf8 {Black wins the queen with a great position. Try again and look
for a better check.}) 21... cxd5 {Good choice! What's next?} 22. Qxd5+ {
[%wrong Black is doing well. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture a pawn with check.]} Kh7 {White's up a pawn, but the position is
complicated. How should White keep control?} 23. Bf4 {[%wrong Black is doing
well. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Attack the pinned
black bishop.] Well played! White keeps the initiative and an extra pawn.
White went on to win in So - Ipatov 2013.1-0 (45) So,W (2710)-Ipatov,A (2584)
Tromsoe 2013} (23. Kg2 $2 Rxf1 {Black has a winning attack. Try again and look
for a way to take advantage of your pin on the d6-bishop.}) (23. Rxf8 $2 Bh2+ {
Black wins the white queen. Try again and look for a way to take advantage of
your pin on the black bishop.}) (23. Qg2 $2 Rxf1+ {Black has a winning attack.
Try again and look for a way to take advantage of your pin on the d6-bishop.})
(23. Qe4 $2 Rxf1+ {Black has a winning attack. Try again and look for a way to
take advantage of your pin on the d6-bishop.}) (23. Qb3 $2 Rxf1+ {Black has a
winning attack. Try again and look for a way to take advantage of your pin on
the d6-bishop.}) *

{How should White offer an exchange and take the initiative against Black's
imprecise move order?} 11. Nd4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it
and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Offer a trade for the c6-knight.]}
(11. Be2 $5 {White has a slight advantage, but there's a stronger move. Try to
find a good way to trade knights.}) (11. Ng5 $5 {White has a slight advantage,
but there's a stronger move. Try to find a good way to trade knights.}) (11.
Bd4 $2 Rhg8 {Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a way to trade
off a defender in front of the black king.}) (11. Bg5 $2 Rhe8 {Black has a
safe position. Try again and look for a way to trade off a defender in front
of the black king.}) (11. Bb5 $5 {White has a slight advantage, but there's a
stronger move. Try to find a better way to attack the c6-knight.}) 11... Nxd4 {
Great move! How should you recapture?} 12. Qxd4 {[%wrong Black has a winning
material advantage. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Recapture
and make a queen-bishop battery.]} (12. Bxd4 $2 Rhg8 {White has only a small
advantage. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (12. cxd4 $2 d5 {
Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 12...
c5 {Black prevents mate, but White can win material. How?} 13. Qxg7 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture
an undefended pawn.] Good work! White wins a pawn and has great chances to win
the game.} *
